name: The Ham Play Park
description: Seaside-themed play park on the Ham at the east end of the seafront, rebuilt by Sidmouth Town Council and reopened in February 2023. It has a zip wire, climbing wall, slides, swings, a trampoline and boat-themed play units, plus a sandpit with 'fossils' hidden in it. A gravel path runs through it, with extra seating and a shaded area.
